KTC's Value Sources

There are three options for you to choose from for the dynasty values that power all of our dynasty tools and resources. Learn more.

Crowdsourced

Values generated from the daily K/T/C question every user answers when they visit the site.

Good measure of community sentiment. Update rapidly in real-time, especially for rookies and players with recent news. Tend to value draft picks more highly.

Tradesourced

Values generated from the millions of real dynasty trades from real dynasty leagues in our Dynasty Trade Database.

Good measure of actionable market sentiment, but subject to trade volume and slower moving – especially for rookies and breaking news.

Crowd+Trades

A best-of-both-worlds blend of the Crowdsourced and Tradesourced values.

Combines the two, maximizing the amount of input data and balancing each of their strengths and weaknesses.

How TE Premium Works

You control the level of premium applied to tight end values. Curious which tier is right for your league/settings? Here are some general guidelines for the three Tight End Premium tiers:

Off

Start 1 TE. No scoring bonus for tight ends.

TE+

Start 1 TE. A mild/moderate scoring bonus for tight ends (a +.5PPR/.75PPR boost, or ~1.5–2x the PPR that WRs receive).

TE++

Start 2 TEs, OR an extreme scoring bonus for tight ends (a >1PPR boost or >2x WR PPR).

TE+++

Start 2 TEs, AND additional scoring bonus(es) for tight ends compared to WRs.

More questions? Learn more about KTC's TE Premium here.
